limitations: Capped 20-Hz draw intervals establish a matched four-actor smoke comparison, not uncapped GPU cost.

Native QA pins Link, camera and time; contact recoil uses an injected AT_HIT flag and visibility uses a shortened native timer. Arrow damage, death, soul emergence and expiry use real native updates/collision.
Ordinary manual defeat and bottle capture were not confirmed; the harness verifies the native soul prompt and expiry.
Composer actors and separate field riding/Big Poes retain native art; composer exclusion is predicate-tested, not a full composer encounter.
Natural graveyard spawns, child Link, wider terrain and third-party texture packs remain additional acceptance coverage.
